parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.sport, t.name, t.description, t.logo_key, t.banner_key, t.category, t.city, t.area, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, t.match_days, t.match_timing, t.format, t.group_count, t.qualify_per_group, t.max_teams, t.squad_min, t.squad_max, t.entry_fee, t.jersey_fee, t.prize_type, t.prize_details, t.food_provided, t.meals, t.jersey_provided, t.jersey_print, DATE_FORMAT(t.registration_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registration_deadline, DATE_FORMAT(t.checklist_deadline, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS checklist_deadline, t.visibility, t.status, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, o.name AS organizer_name, o.photo_key AS organizer_photo_key, o.is_verified AS organizer_verified, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournaments x WHERE x.organizer_user_id = o.id AND x.status = 'COMPLETED') AS organizer_completed, r.match_rules, r.points, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(g.name) FROM tournament_grounds g WHERE g.tournament_id = t.id) AS grounds, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'doc_type', d.doc_type, 'title', d.title, 'file_key', d.file_key, 'mime_type', d.mime_type, 'size_bytes', d.size_bytes, 'sort_order', d.sort_order)) FROM tournament_documents d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS documents, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'label', s.label, 'is_title', s.is_title, 'logo_key', s.logo_key, 'banner_key', s.banner_key, 'link_url', s.link_url, 'tagline', s.tagline, 'sort_order', s.sort_order, 'views', (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(z.views), 0) FROM sponsor_daily_stats z WHERE z.sponsor_id = s.id), 'taps', (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(z.taps), 0) FROM sponsor_daily_stats z WHERE z.sponsor_id = s.id))) FROM tournament_sponsors s WHERE s.tournament_id = t.id) AS sponsors, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', v.id, 'name', v.name, 'sort_order', v.sort_order, 'min_age', v.min_age, 'max_age', v.max_age, 'format', v.format, 'group_count', v.group_count, 'qualify_per_group', v.qualify_per_group, 'max_teams', v.max_teams, 'squad_min', v.squad_min, 'squad_max', v.squad_max, 'entry_fee', v.entry_fee, 'prize_type', v.prize_type, 'prize_details', v.prize_details, 'match_rules', v.match_rules, 'points', v.points, 'approved_teams', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = v.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED'))) FROM tournament_divisions v WHERE v.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions, p.upi_id, p.upi_name, p.qr_key, p.accept_cash, p.note AS payment_note, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved_teams FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users o ON o.id = t.organizer_user_id LEFT JOIN tournament_rules r ON r.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tournament_payment_details p ON p.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2
